advancement_rule.scope: A pass is permission for a preregistered full-population evaluation, not release evidence.

cache_contract.attempt_local_rule: Every payload, sidecar, and index lives under the admitted run exclusive attempt/cache directory. The cache reference and progress are attempt-local, and result.json is the separately declared result manifest.
cache_contract.hash_rule: Worker must read each actual frame and compute/recheck hashes. A preregistered input hash mismatch fails the run; no missing output hash may be filled from expectation.
cache_contract.result_artifact_rule: Worker result artifact_sha256 must exactly cover cache-index.json, both NPZ payloads, both manifest sidecars, cache-reference.json, and progress.json; result.json is bound separately by result_manifest_path.

classification: These four fold0 outer clips and frames 0/50 were inspected in the 2026-09-07 precision audit and partial outer evaluation. They are diagnostic data and are not held-out or release evidence.

full_population_followup_required: fixed-linker adjusted edge score on identical coverage
estimated-node count ratio on the metric population
completeness_gate.missing_value_rule: Any missing, null, partial-coverage, mismatched-identity, failed parity, or nonfinite metric makes the candidate ineligible. Isolated-frame pilot results remain diagnostic even when all frame-level fields are complete.

device_fidelity.control_rule: Native and float32 activation replay use the payload original CUDA device. A CPU replay is a separately labeled device-change diagnostic and cannot establish bitwise control parity.

tta.reason: The frozen learned production source has no TTA. Enabling any transform requires a new TTA identity and implementation.

extraction_variants.definition: 3x3x3 nearest-mode equality maxima followed by existing anisotropic NMS and 2000-node safeguard
26-connected equal-score local maxima, physical-centroid representative with lexicographic tie break, then deterministic physical NMS

hypothesis: Native float16 activation ties and legacy equal-maximum handling explain a measurable part of frozen fold0 detector count inflation without requiring fitting.

initial_grid.rationale: Thresholds are the three values used by the frozen campaign and prior audit. Radius 3.0 um is control; 2.0 and 4.0 bracket it in physical space using the recorded anisotropic scale. No public-reference threshold is transferred.

population.coverage_limit: Isolated frames do not contain the complete temporal population needed for fixed-linker or clip-level adjusted-score evidence.
population.selection_time: frozen before this pilot from the prior eight-frame audit

post_run_requirements: Verify every remote model/source/config hash before admission.
Verify every worker input-frame hash against this plan after the actual frame read.
Require COMPLETE result.json with matching run, intent, fencing token and run-spec SHA-256.
Reload every NPZ through the strict learned cache reader and verify manifest and per-array hashes.
On original CUDA device, compare native replay bitwise with production frame_probabilities before using control metrics.
Write a single complete metrics table over identical eight-frame coverage and preserve per-frame rows.
Keep unavailable full-temporal metrics explicitly missing and block advancement.

precision_variants.activation: native recorded dtype on original CUDA device
runtime_assertions: reconstructed probability is bitwise equal to contemporaneous production frame_probabilities

precision_variants.model_forward: same cached CUDA-autocast logits as control

refinement_policy.anchor_selection: Highest annotated recall, then lowest node count, then highest threshold, then smallest radius, then lexical variant id.
refinement_policy.candidates: For the selected anchor only, evaluate threshold midpoints to each adjacent initial threshold at the anchor radius and radius midpoints to each adjacent initial radius at the anchor threshold; omit out-of-range neighbors and duplicates.
refinement_policy.stop: No second refinement, no threshold/radius extension, and no choice from held-out or leaderboard results.
refinement_policy.trigger: After every initial configuration has complete frame-level metrics, choose one precision/extraction variant whose best initial candidate has recall loss <=0.01 and cap rate <= control but has not met the count reduction target. If none exists, skip refinement.

resource_bounds.gpu_launch: Controller only; this plan performs no launch.
resource_bounds.streaming_peak_contract: One raw frame and one tile payload at a time; never materialize a 4D video.
resource_bounds.time_statement: These are workload counts and hard deadlines from geometry. They are not a measured throughput claim; record observed stage timing from the Vast run.
